actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE complete native 1024x1024 transparent RGBA game animation sprite, no sheet.
Reference 1 is the exact character identity; reference 2 is the approved hand-painted rendering style only. Same bamboo archer girl, bright clean rounded Chinese Daoist chibi, 2.4 heads tall, large green eyes, brown high ponytail with green bamboo-leaf jade and gold ornament, ivory and jade-green gold-edged short robes and white shorts, original yin-yang belt buckle and jade tassel, matching green white gold boots, original quiver.
Camera fixed orthographic slightly from above 10 degrees. Direction E: she walks directly toward screen RIGHT; exact right-facing SIDE PROFILE, face and chest face RIGHT, one green eye visible, left side behind near right side. NOT front or rear three-quarter.
This is walk cycle E frame 01 of 16. Genuine LEFT foot forward heel contact toward screen-right; RIGHT foot extended behind toward screen-left with toe still supporting, legs anatomically separate. Gentle normal walking, NOT running, both feet not airborne. Right arm swings forward opposite left leg; left hand securely carries long bamboo bow at its middle, not aiming, elbow bent to keep bottom tip off ground. The bow retains reference size, around 80 percent of full character height, thin golden resting string, NO nocked arrow. Keep bow fully visible.
Entire character including ponytail, feet and full bow occupies about 84% of square height, centered on ground root (512,942) on 1024 canvas. Fixed character scale for this direction and all frames, clean uniform studio lighting. Transparent alpha background, NO shadow, NO ground, NO colored matte. Edges must be clean without red, magenta or yellow halo. Match reference costume and equipment exactly; no text, border, montage or secondary pose. Render with the highest host-managed visual quality.
Critical edge instruction: the original identity reference has stray magenta chroma pixels outside silhouette; ignore them entirely. Draw new smooth neutral antialiased transparent edges, no inherited colored fringe. Anatomical LEFT hand holds bow; right hand free.
